name: PromptCraft Issue Template Policy
purpose: Define how issues should be structured so that contributors and agents can start work without re-asking the same questions.

feature: What should the new behavior be?
research: What are we trying to learn?
What sample size or test flow is enough?
What result would change the plan?
docs: Which template or policy is affected?

triageRules: Prefer one issue per actionable slice
Document the acceptance criteria before implementation starts
Link the relevant docs or phase notes
Mark risky work clearly so it can be reviewed separately
